newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products stronger on back of crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products stronger on back of crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Thursday, traders said.
Gas oil firmed $4 on stronger futures. Higher February demand lifted French heating oil $2. Barges remained lethargic.
High sulphur fuel oil barges recovered further after recent losses. Barges traded early at $101 fob ARA then rose up to $104 supported by good bunker demand.
Gasoline gained $1-2 a tonne on the back of stronger crude prices while naphtha made up to $3 a tonne tracking crude.
